name: GlobalNavigation
description: Link-only implementation of the GNav bar geometry. Fixed dark context, native mobile disclosure, responsive non-clipping labels. Partial parity: mega-menus, App Switcher, signed-in states, and remaining context/background axes are not implemented.

notes: Native anchors navigate; no inert dropdown affordances.
Mobile summary toggles the navigation. Escape closes it and returns focus.
Initialize GlobalNavigationController and destroy it when unmounting.
